Author: Deepak Verma
Bench: Deepak Verma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:131007
Court No. - 67
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 55308 of 2023
Applicant :- Shubham Tripathi

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Siddharth Niranjan,Vaibhav Goswami
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Mahendra Bahadur Singh,Shashank Singh
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
1.

Heard Sri Dharam Pal Singh, learned Senior Advocate assisted by Sri Vaibhav Goswami, learned
counsel for the applicant, Sri Shashank Singh, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2.  The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No. 350 of 2023, registered under Sections 498A, 304B I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of DP Act, Police Station Colonelganj, District Prayagraj during pendency of the trial.

3. As per prosecution story, applicant, who is husband of the deceased, solemnized marriage with informant's sister on 07.02.2023 thereafter members of her in-laws constantly demanding additional dowry and harassed the deceased and subsequently, when demand was not fulfilled, the deceased was murdered by her in-laws.

Shubham Tripathi vs State Of U.P. on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5660416/

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case due to ulterior motive.
The applicant has been intentionally dragged in the present case.

Applicant is husband of the deceased and when deceased consumed poison,
applicant immediately took her to hospital but she could not be saved by the doctor's team.
Allegation of demand of dowry is totally false and baseless.
Deceased was second year law student and she was studying after marriage by the support of applicant.
Cause of death is due to consumption of Aluminium phosphide.

During course of investigation, Investigating Officer received two affidavits dated 20.09.2023, one of the mother of the deceased and second one is of brother of the deceased that they are not supporting the prosecution case.
It is a case of suicide.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 18.07.2023.
In case, the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and co-operate in trial.

5. Per contra, learned counsel for the informant as well as learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer of the applicant and submit that marriage of applicant and deceased was solemnized on 07.02.2023 and within five months of the marriage deceased died in unnatural circumstances in the house of the applicant.
Deceased was a second year law student and she was of strong temperament and would not commit suicide.
Applicant is husband of the deceased and presumption is against him.
The conduct of applicant is that during investigation forged affidavits in regard to brother and mother of the deceased have been placed.
The affidavits were forged and fabricated documents.
Deceased was talented young girl as she had completed other academic courses and got many certificates under Rajeev Gandhi Computer Saksharta Mission.

6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and submissions advanced by learned counsel for the parties, deceased, who died in unnatural circumstances within five months of her marriage and presumption is against the applicant, who is husband of the deceased and applicant has to prove his innocence, prima facie, evidences are agaisnt the applicant, as such, looking to seriousness and gravity of offence, evidence, complicity of the accused, I do not find it is a fit case for bail to the applicant.
7. Accordingly, the bail application of the applicant-Shubham Tripathi, involved in the aforesaid case crime, is hereby rejected at this stage.

Order Date :- 13.8.2024 Nitin Verma  Shubham Tripathi vs State Of U.P. on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5660416/
